fact: Budget tables: 100,864,138,247 MGA is published as actually spent on digital lines for 2025. Dated by the document that gives the figure.

The Cour des comptes audit says the e-Fokontany project spent 21,541,224,988.66 Ariary over 2022-2025, financed by the MNDPT general budget, the MNDPT annex budget, the FDTIC, the Presidency and PRODIGY; the figure is a four-year total, not a single year, and no split by year is given.

The audit says the FDTIC (Fonds de Développement des Télécommunications et des TIC) was created and is managed by the telecoms minister for sector policy, and that it made large expenditures in 2022-2025, including part-financing the e-Fokontany project; the creating law or decree is not named and no amount collected is given.
